title: Proteomic Analysis of Generative and Vegetative Nuclei Reveals Molecular Characteristics of Pollen Cell Differentiation in Lily.
authors: You, Chen; Zhang, YuPing; Yang, ShaoYu; Wang, Xu; Yao, Wen; Jin, WeiHuan; Wang, Wei; Hu, XiuLi; Yang, Hao
one_liner_zh: 该文通过定量蛋白质组学分析百合花粉营养核与生殖核的差异核蛋白，虽涉及转录因子鉴定，但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，属于纯实验组学分析，与本课题核心方法无关。
abstract: In plants, the cell fates of a vegetative cell (VC) and generative cell (GC) are determined after the asymmetric division of the haploid microspore. The VC exits the cell cycle and grows a pollen tube, while the GC undergoes further mitosis to produce two sperm cells for double fertilization. However, our understanding of the mechanisms underlying their fate differentiation remains limited. One major advantage of the nuclear proteome analysis is that it is the only method currently able to uncover the systemic differences between VC and GC due to GC being engulfed within the cytoplasm of VC, limiting the use of transcriptome. Here, we obtained pure preparations of the vegetative cell nuclei (VNs) and generative cell nuclei (GNs) from germinating lily pollens. Utilizing these high-purity VNs and GNs, we compared the differential nucleoproteins between them using state-of-the-art quantitative proteomic techniques. We identified 720 different amount proteins (DAPs) and grouped the results in 11 fate differentiation categories. Among them, we identified 29 transcription factors (TFs) and 10 cell fate determinants. Significant differences were found in the molecular activities of vegetative and reproductive nuclei. The TFs in VN mainly participate in pollen tube development. In comparison, the TFs in GN are mainly involved in cell differentiation and male gametogenesis. The identified novel TFs may play an important role in cell fate differentiation. Our data also indicate differences in nuclear pore complexes and epigenetic modifications: more nucleoporins synthesized in VN; more histone variants and chaperones; and structural maintenance of chromosome (SMC) proteins, chromatin remodelers, and DNA methylation-related proteins expressed in GN. The VC has active macromolecular metabolism and mRNA processing, while GC has active nucleic acid metabolism and translation. Moreover, the members of unfolded protein response (UPR) and programmed cell death accumulate in VN, and DNA damage repair is active in GN. Differences in the stress response of DAPs in VN vs. GN were also found. This study provides a further understanding of pollen cell differentiation mechanisms and also a sound basis for future studies of the molecular mechanisms behind cell fate differentiation.
abstract_zh: 在植物中，营养细胞（vegetative cell, VC）和生殖细胞（generative cell, GC）的细胞命运是在单倍体小孢子不对称分裂后决定的。VC退出细胞周期并生长出花粉管，而GC则经历进一步的 mitosis 以产生两个精子细胞用于双受精。然而，我们对它们命运分化机制的理解仍然有限。核蛋白质组分析的一个主要优势在于，由于GC被包裹在VC的细胞质内，限制了转录组的使用，因此它是目前唯一能够揭示VC和GC之间系统性差异的方法。在此，我们从萌发的百合花粉中获得了营养细胞核（vegetative cell nuclei, VNs）和生殖细胞核（generative cell nuclei, GNs）的纯化制备物。利用这些高纯度的VNs和GNs，我们采用最先进的定量蛋白质组学技术比较了它们之间的差异核蛋白。我们鉴定了720种差异丰度蛋白（DAPs），并将其结果归类为11个命运分化类别。其中，我们识别出29个转录因子（TFs）和10个细胞命运决定因子。在营养核和生殖核的分子活性方面发现了显著差异。VN中的TFs主要参与花粉管发育。相比之下，GN中的TFs主要涉及细胞分化和雄性配子发生。所识别的新型TFs可能在细胞命运分化中发挥重要作用。我们的数据还表明，核孔复合体和表观遗传修饰存在差异：VN中合成了更多的核孔蛋白；GN中表达了更多的组蛋白变体和伴侣蛋白，以及染色体结构维持（structural maintenance of chromosome, SMC）蛋白、染色质重塑因子和DNA甲基化相关蛋白。VC具有活跃的大分子代谢和mRNA加工，而GC具有活跃的核酸代谢和翻译。此外，未折叠蛋白反应（unfolded protein response, UPR）和程序性细胞死亡的成员在VN中积累，而DNA损伤修复在GN中活跃。还发现了VN与GN中DAPs应激反应的差异。本研究提供了对花粉细胞分化机制的进一步理解，也为未来研究细胞命运分化背后的分子机制奠定了坚实基础。
